label: Glyph Typography
mood: typographic art — the picture is made of letterforms: a giant character cropped by its column with a second one overprinted, a type-specimen grid of repeated glyphs, or a solid letter in front of stepped outline echoes, printed in two or three flat inks with a faint letterpress mottle. Confident, graphic, editorial. Good for design and type events, exhibitions, book fairs and literature, brand launches, school and language programmes.

text.note: the characters the picture is made of, in order (first = hero). Left unset, the first letters of the headline's words are used

font.note: black (Black Han Sans) | sans (Pretendard Black) | serif (Hahmlet Black) | display (Anton, Latin; Hangul falls back to Black Han Sans)

echoes.note: echo motif: number of stepped copies behind the letter, 3–24

marks.note: small specimen marks (code point, face name) in a free corner

print.note: letterpress mottle and paper tooth, 0 = clean vector … 2 = worn

giant.note: one giant character cropped by the edges of its column, a second overprinted in another ink

grid.note: a type-specimen grid: the characters repeated cell by cell in several faces, a big hero cell, cells cleared around the copy

echo.note: a solid letter in front of a run of outline echoes stepping back towards the open side
